description:
Free read-only planner for SAP agent registration, profile/image updates, Metaplex/MPL Core identity linking, SNS linking, x402 pricing metadata, and post-write verification. Use this before sap_payments_register_agent or sap_payments_update_agent so agents know the exact local-signer route, metadata contract, forbidden actions, and protocol fee verification checklist. It does not touch chain and never signs. SAP MCP context: Direct synapse-sap-sdk wrapper served by this MCP. Read tools return on-chain state; write tools require signer policy, configured RPC, and the active SAP profile.

SAP MCP execution guidance: Intent: agent bootstrap, routing, skills, or repair guidance. Pricing: free; call directly without x402. Routing: free hosted call; call directly and keep it small/exact when possible. Signer boundary: hosted reads/builders never receive keypair bytes; value-moving results must be finalized locally when signing is required.

inputSchema.description: Plan SAP Agent Identity input schema. Intent: agent bootstrap, routing, skills, or repair guidance. Pricing: free; call directly without x402. Routing: free hosted call; call directly and keep it small/exact when possible. Signer boundary: hosted reads/builders never receive keypair bytes; value-moving results must be finalized locally when signing is required. Use exact field names from this schema; do not guess aliases or include private key material.

agentId.description: Optional stable lowercase agent id, for example solking. This is separate from the on-chain agent PDA.

agentUri.description: Optional public HTTPS/IPFS/Arweave/Kommodo URI for the agent profile metadata or profile page. Never use local desktop file paths.

capabilities.description: Required capability list. Prefer object form for production; strings are accepted as shorthand.

items.description: Capabilities array describing agent/tool capabilities. Use stable IDs, protocol labels, and human-readable descriptions; validate category values before writes.

oneOf.description: Capability id shorthand, for example jupiter:swap, pyth:price, metaplex:identity, sns:identity, or risk:management.
Capabilities array describing agent/tool capabilities. Use stable IDs, protocol labels, and human-readable descriptions; validate category values before writes.

description.description: Optional human-readable capability description for agents and explorers.

id.description: Required stable capability id. Use protocol:action naming, for example jupiter:swap, pyth:price, metaplex:identity, sns:identity, x402:payments, or risk:management.

protocolId.description: Optional protocol namespace backing this capability, for example sap, mcp, jupiter, pyth, metaplex, sns, x402, or custom.

version.description: Optional capability version string. Use semver when the capability maps to an API contract.

description.description: Required public description of what the agent does, which protocols it can use, and its safety/trust boundaries.

imageUrl.description: Optional public image URL. This must be HTTPS, IPFS, Arweave, or another public URI; desktop file paths are not valid.

intendedAction.description: Agent identity lifecycle step to plan. Use register for a new SAP agent, update for profile/image/capability changes, link-metaplex for NFT/MPL Core identity, link-sns for .sol identity, or full-identity for the recommended end-to-end flow.

metadataUri.description: Alias for agentUri. Prefer a public JSON metadata document containing name, description, image, external_url, attributes, sap, metaplex, sns, and x402 fields.

metaplexAsset.description: Optional Metaplex NFT or MPL Core asset/collection address to reference from public agent metadata.

name.description: Required public display name for the SAP agent. Keep it stable enough for explorers and humans.

ownerWallet.description: Optional expected SAP owner wallet. Use this for verification planning only; signing still comes from the active local SAP profile.

pricing.description: Optional pricing tiers advertised by the agent. Use tokenType usdc + settlementMode x402 for pay.sh/x402 agent commerce.

items.description: Pricing array of x402/pay.sh pricing tiers for the registered agent or tool. Amounts should be denominated explicitly in USDC smallest units when applicable.

batchIntervalSec.description: Optional settlement batch interval in seconds when settlementMode is batched.

burstLimit.description: Optional short-window burst allowance for this tier.

maxCallsPerSession.description: Maximum calls allowed per session for this tier. Defaults to 1000.

maxPricePerCall.description: Optional ceiling price per call in the smallest unit of tokenType.

minEscrowDeposit.description: Optional minimum escrow deposit in the smallest unit of tokenType.

minPricePerCall.description: Optional floor price per call in the smallest unit of tokenType.

pricePerCall.description: Price per call in the smallest unit of tokenType: lamports for sol, micro-USDC for usdc, or base units for spl.

rateLimit.description: Maximum calls per second allowed by this tier. Defaults to 60.

settlementMode.description: Settlement strategy. Use x402 for HTTP 402/pay.sh flows, escrow for prepaid SAP usage ledgers, instant for direct pay-per-call, and batched for periodic settlement.

tierId.description: Stable tier id, for example default, read, premium, value-action, or enterprise.

tokenDecimals.description: Decimals for the payment token. Defaults to 6 for usdc and 9 for sol when omitted.

tokenMint.description: Optional SPL token mint public key. Required when tokenType is spl. For mainnet USDC use EPjFWdd5AufqSSqeM2qN1xzybapC8G4wEGGkZwyTDt1v.

tokenType.description: Payment token type. Use usdc for x402/pay.sh agent commerce. Use spl only with tokenMint.

volumeCurve.description: Optional volume discounts. Each item lowers pricePerCall after a call threshold.

items.description: Volume Curve parameter for Plan SAP Agent Identity.

afterCalls.description: Call count threshold where this price starts.

pricePerCall.description: Discounted price per call in the smallest unit of tokenType.

protocols.description: Required protocol tags the agent supports, for example sap, mcp, jupiter, pyth, metaplex, sns, x402, payments.

items.description: Protocols array of protocol identifiers such as sap, mcp, jupiter, pyth, metaplex, sns, or x402.

snsDomain.description: Optional .sol domain to link after ownership or registration is verified.

x402Endpoint.description: Optional public x402 discovery/payment endpoint, usually https://host/.well-known/x402 for external agent services.

name: sap_agent_identity_plan

content.description: MCP content blocks returned to the caller.

text.description: Human-readable JSON or text returned by the tool.

type.description: MCP content block type, usually text.

isError.description: True when the tool result represents an application-level error.
